Occurrences.Kwic: 有佛世界。以光明為佛事。普照今日也恁麼去也。還會麼。燈連鳳翅當堂照。月印娥眉䫌面看。上堂云。習習春風絲絲春雨。一等沾濡十方周普。甘草得之甜。黃連得之苦。天意發叢林。簷聲鬧窓戶。古德甞云。已不迷。等閑教壞人男女。大眾已既不迷。為甚教壞人男女。還會麼。出身猶可易。脫體道還難。參上堂舉玄沙云。撈籠不肯住。呼喚不回頭。古聖不安排。至今無處所。據普照門下祇成得箇擔版漢。到這裡。却須把得住喚得回。退位相承。借功相見。直得同聲相應。雅合宮商。同道相忘。不分堦級。還會麼。鷺鷥立雪非同色。明月蘆花不似他。上堂云。不墮虛凝體前運步。不迷照用。鬧裡分身。可謂。獨立而不改。周行而不殆。還會麼。機絲不掛梭頭事。文彩縱橫意自殊。上堂

Hongzhi Zhengjue owns the retained deployment: raises Xuansha's couplet in hall, the cage that cannot hold it and the call that wins no turn of the head, the old sages arranging nothing so that today it has no dwelling-place, rules that under Puzhao this makes only a plank-carrying fellow, and that here one must rather hold it fast and call it back, shared sounds answering with pitch and measure and equals on the way forgetting rank.

Occurrences.Kwic: 堂。默時說。說時默。寒山逢拾得。拈箇禿掃󰆠。東掃西掃。忽然撞著豐干禪師騎虎出來。放下苕󰆠。把手呵呵大笑。恰似販私鹽底草賊。有什麼共語處。復召大眾云。且道。他笑箇什麼。良久云。東君行正令。花發樹南枝。喝一喝。上堂。撥轉天關。掀翻地軸。氷凌上走馬。劍刃上翻身。未是衲僧行履處。萬年一念。一念萬年。羅籠不肯住。呼喚不回頭。亦未是衲僧行履處。透脫兩重窠臼。別有生機一路。向百草頭上。罷却干戈。山僧甘心。生陷無間地獄。是汝諸人。還自撿責麼。喝一喝云。漆桶參堂去。上堂。今朝正月半。普請大家看。過去燈明如來。在汝諸人脚跟下。放光動地。還見麼。若也見得。神頭鬼面裏。元來有人在。若見不得。切忌撞牆撞壁。復舉明招到招慶。有度上座問。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1999.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Mi’an. Mi'an Xianjie owns the retained deployment: spinning the heaven-pivot and overturning the earth-axis, riding horse on the ice and turning over on the sword-blade, rules that still not the patch-robed one's practice-ground, that ten thousand years one thought, one thought ten thousand years, the cage that cannot hold him and the call that does not turn him back, is still not the practice-ground either, and that through two stacked burrows there is another road of live functioning, the feud ended on the hundred-grass tips, himself willing to fall alive into the unbroken hell.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1359.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Ying’an Tanhua. Ying'an Tanhua owns the retained deployment: bidden to the dais at the water-land rite for the late retired minister's brother, holds that though the man showed the world a going and a coming, his very body moves not and changes not, and so the cage cannot hold him and the call wins no turning of the head, buddhas and patriarchs arranging nothing and no dwelling-place to this day, every mote and every land showing its awesome light and each thing fully declaring its surpassing mark, and asks where the retired minister is just now, the killing-and-living vajra sword in hand and none daring look him full in the face.

Occurrences.Kwic: ，磵底游魚忙不徹，展似眉毛作麼生？分明底事叮嚀說。諸昆仲！且道叮嚀事作麼生？雙手拍開銀世界，縱橫誰辯往來源？上堂。至理不渝，至功不宰，至道不形，至了不辦。於此四句相應，便做箇灑落衲僧，眼不染玄黃，脚不沾泥水，意不緣諸法，舌不親玄旨。到此則圓機普應，玄度該通，淨體無依，靈明絕待。所以玄沙大師云：羅籠不肯住，呼喚不回頭。古聖不安排，至今無處所。諸昆仲！今時禪者不信自心是佛，向外求佛；不信自心具足諸法，向外求法。既昧自心，縱有弘為，皆生死之業耳。又當知求佛求法即有所依，既有所依，於自心不得自在。譬如窮子竛竮辛苦，乞食自濟，昧却衣裏無價寶珠，豈智者乎？夾山大師偈云：勞持生死法，惟向佛邊求。目前迷正理，撥火覓浮漚。無事，久立。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X72/X72n1435.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Wuyi Yuanlai. Wuyi Yuanlai owns the retained deployment: cites the great master Xuansha's four lines for the brothers, then faults the men of this age who, not trusting their own mind to be buddha, seek the buddha outside, and not trusting their own mind to hold all dharmas, seek dharmas outside, so that all their vast undertaking turns to the business of birth-and-death, and seeking they get a prop, and by the prop lose freedom in their own mind, like the poor son laboring for food and forgetting the priceless pearl sewn in his coat.

Yinyuan Longqi owns the retained deployment: asking the brothers who came to Mount Huangbo, brows knit and nostrils pressed together, whether they have ever once broken out, holds that burst out, the cage will not hold them and the call will not turn them, seven ways through and eight roads open, going east going west at their own leave to kill and give life, yet they must still know the one road of the turned body, and to the question what that road is, answers that you walk the wild grass and I go deeper into the village.

Senses.Explanation: Xuansha's untamed thing, which the cage cannot hold and calling cannot fetch back. Hongzhi Zhengjue raises Xuansha's couplet in hall, the cage that cannot hold it and the call that wins no turn of the head, the old sages arranging nothing so that today it has no dwelling-place, rules that under Puzhao this makes only a plank-carrying fellow and here one must rather hold it fast and call it back, shared sounds answering with pitch and measure and equals forgetting rank, Mi'an Xianjie, spinning the heaven-pivot and overturning the earth-axis, riding horse on the ice and turning over on the sword-blade, rules that still not the practice-ground, that ten thousand years one thought with the cage that cannot hold and the call that does not turn back still not the practice-ground either, and past two stacked burrows another road of live functioning, the feud ended on the hundred-grass tips, Ying'an Tanhua, bidden to the dais at the water-land rite for the late retired minister's brother, holds that though the man showed the world a going and a coming his very body moves not and changes not, so the cage cannot hold him and the call wins no turning of the head, every mote and land showing its awesome light, and asks where the minister is now, the killing-and-living vajra sword in hand, and Wuyi Yuanlai, citing the great master Xuansha's four lines, faults the men of this age who not trusting their own mind to be buddha seek the buddha outside, like the poor son laboring for food and forgetting the priceless pearl sewn in his coat.
